## RawExpression interface

A fragment of literal SQL that is emitted verbatim rather than quoted.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface RawExpression 
```

## Remarks

Created by [raw()](./database.raw.md)<!-- -->, and accepted anywhere a value would be — most often a column default. Because the contents bypass quoting entirely, never build one from user input.
